title: The Abyss That Looks Back
description:
Name: [The Leviathan](image:tumblrbumblr:textures/quests/photos/leviathan.png:150:150)
Known Locations: The Sunken City, locate in Deep Oceans.
Estimated Size: Huge
Behavior: Summoned through the usage of an [Abyssal Sacrifice](image:tumblrbumblr:textures/quests/abyssal_sacrifice.png:124:127). Lives exclusively submerged in water, posessing several tentacles and jaws. It is known to create abyssal mines scattered in the water. When driven into a corner, it can achieve a second wind. [It is recommended to bless meat from Amethyst Crabs found in Lush Caves at an Altar of Amethyst](image:tumblrbumblr:textures/quest/blessed_amethyst_crab_meat.png:133:67)
Danger Level: §8§lDeadly
